facts.fact: The Ministry of Digital Transition officially launched the Administration Interoperability Platform (Cybernetica UXP, X-Road based) on 25 September 2025, with twelve pilot bodies in its first phase, including the tax directorate, civil status office, social security fund and Abidjan commercial court; led by SNDI.
